paper_id: BPI_ A Novel Efficient and Reliable Search Structure for Hybrid Storage Blockchain
title: BPI: A Novel Efficient and Reliable Search Structure for Hybrid Storage Blockchain
motivation: Hybrid storage blockchain faces query completeness verification problem where malicious SPs can omit valid results while passing ADS verification; high B+ tree maintenance overhead in high-frequency transaction blockchain
problem_framing: 定义如何利用区块链只读特性避免全量扫描；如何在保证验证安全性的同时压缩VO通信开销；如何实现常数级插入复杂度的索引结构
key_insight: Blockchain immutability allows users to skip previously queried data and focus on new data only, enabling Articulated Search via stop-location tokens to narrow search scope
method_signature: BMF+ forest structure with feature mask encoding and bitwise operations; CRC-based variable-length VO compression for fine-grained validation
evaluation_criteria: Search performance对比B+树和EthMB+; maintenance overhead; storage space reduction; verification communication overhead
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: BPI is restricted to keyword searches and may not fully cover conditional and range queries due to lack of support for arbitrary interval queries
evidence_for_taste: B+ tree queries introduce unnecessary overhead
achieves balance between security and communication overhead
thinking_moves: 利用区块链只读特性重新定义搜索问题：跳过旧数据只查新数据
将树结构遍历替换为位运算和mask编码加速查询
从对数级插入复杂度转向常数级插入复杂度设计
区分粗粒度与细粒度验证，选择细粒度可降低重复验证成本
借鉴数据去重思想跳过零mask避免存储
